Hi,

unfortunately there are too many changes in a single for GitLab UI, preventing it from doing a review. Presumably this shoudld be split in several smaller commits, otherwise the review is gonna be complex.
Moreover your patch reintroduces the use of the wmem_packet_scope() that is in the process of being deprecated while 34ee3cbc489444bf07818826519e176dc63f3307 changed them to pinfo->pool. Please modify the patch to use pinfo->pool instead of wmem_packet_scope().

Hi @pquantin, please take your time to review it. It is very hard for me to split this PR since Microsoft internally is using this tool for testing and developing new MBIM version. If it is split, it will be very hard to have a private Wireshark that all commands are dissected. Fortunately, all updates are from a single file. I really appreciate you can accommodate it. Thanks very much.
@pquantin, for wmem_packet_scope(), is it ok to replace it all in a separate PR? If you don't mind to mix it in this PR, I can replace all wmem_packet_scope() with pinfo->pool in this PR also.

It canbot be reviewed for the reasons given above: it does not work with GitLab. So split it in several commits (I do not see how this would create any issue with your internal build).
And no you should not put the pinfo->pool change in a separate commit as your current patch remove a code change done on purpose.
I see. Let me split the PR command by mbim function. I will keep this PR open for my refence and will abandon it after all changes are merged.
